formulas.formula: One small deposit a week. A big win by the end of the year.
Setup: pick a start date and a style. Classic saves $1 in week 1, $2 in week 2 ... $52 in week 52.
Setup: change the step to $2, $5 or $10 to save more. Step $5 = $6,890 in a year.
Challenge: tick Done each week. Saved a different amount? Type it in Actual.
Board: watch the grid fill up in color as you go.
Dashboard: saved so far, this week's amount, and whether you're ahead or behind.
Biggest weeks first, while motivation is high. Easier in December.
Weeks in a random order. Pick an easy week when money is tight.
Set a fixed amount, like $25 a week.
No stress. Double up next week and tick both.
Pink = missed. Catch up when you can.
52 weeks from now, you'll be glad you started today.

section_bars.label: SAVED VS PLAN, WEEK BY WEEK

formulas.formula: =IF(R4=52,"All 52 weeks done. You did it!",IF('Setup'!$R$9<1,"Your challenge starts "&TEXT('Setup'!$R$5,"mmm d")&". Get ready!",IF('Setup'!$R$9>52,"The 52 weeks are up. Tick any weeks you finished.",IF(INDEX('Challenge'!$K$6:$K$57,'Setup'!$R$9)=1,"This week is done. Nice work!","This week: save "&TEXT(R7,"$#,##0.00")&" by "&TEXT('Setup'!$R$5+7*'Setup'!$R$9-1,"ddd mmm d")&"."))))
Classic, Reverse, Same every week or Shuffled.
Used by the Same every week style.

Tick Done each week. Saved a different amount? Type it in Actual (it wins over the plan).
Teal = done. Pink = missed. Cream = still to come.
Weeks are counted in the month they start.
